advance.title: Advances to associates
advance.question: Where does the advance come from?
advance.sourceCompanyText: An advance on their profit: it shows in their ledger and cash only moves when they withdraw it. Deducted from their next share.
advance.sourceAssociateText: Part of the lender's balance moves to the receiving associate, who can withdraw it. Cash only moves on withdrawal.
advance.effectCompanyDebt: {name} receives an advance of {amount}: they can withdraw it (Withdrawals tab) and owe it to the company.
advance.effectDeduction: This amount will be deducted automatically from their next validated profit share.
advance.effectAssociateDebt: {lender}'s balance goes down by {amount} and {name}'s goes up by {amount}: they can withdraw it (Withdrawals tab).
advance.effectNoTreasury: No bank or cash movement now: money only goes out on withdrawal.
advance.effectRepayAssociate: The repayment moves the amount back from their account to the lender's (“Repay” button).
advance.lenderTooLow: The lender's available balance is too low for this advance.
advance.confirmCompany: Grant an advance of {amount} to {name}? It will be deducted from their next profit share.
advance.confirmAssociate: Record an advance of {amount} from {lender} to {name}?
advance.autoDeductionHint: Will be deducted automatically from their next validated profit share.
advance.repayCompanyHelp: The part never withdrawn is simply cancelled (cash does not move). Only what they really withdrew comes back into an account. Otherwise the advance is deducted from their next profit share.
advance.repayAssociateHelp: The amount moves back from {name}'s balance to {lender}'s, with no bank or cash movement.
advance.repayTooHigh: The amount exceeds what is left to repay.
advance.effectNoTreasuryYet: No bank or cash movement now: money only goes out when they make the withdrawal.
advance.effectAssociateOwes: {name} owes {amount} to {lender}: a debt in their ledger, a claim in {lender}'s.
advance.repaySplitCancel: {amount} never withdrawn: cancelled, no cash movement.
advance.repaySplitCash: {amount} withdrawn earlier: paid back into cash or bank.
